name: wifit3
one_liner: A tool professional security testers plug a USB Wi-Fi adapter into to check how easily a company's wireless network could be broken into.
buyer: An independent penetration tester or small security-consulting firm doing authorized Wi-Fi security audits for small businesses.
business_use_cases: A security consultant runs it during an authorized on-site audit of a retail chain's guest Wi-Fi and hands over a findings report.
An IT provider for small businesses uses it as part of an annual 'network health check' add-on service.
A cybersecurity trainer uses it in a hands-on workshop teaching Wi-Fi security fundamentals.

money_ideas.idea: Charge per Wi-Fi security audit engagement using it as one of several tools.

steal_this: This is a professional security tool, not a productizable weekend app — the business is the audit service around it, which needs real certification and client trust, not a weekend build.
